Hence tangent eigen modulus beta r/3 crosses 1 transversally at beta_c=3/r. The quadratic conjugate term is nonresonant for interior epsilon, with cubic normal form Re(bar(a)d)=-3/(4r^2) <0; excluding epsilon=2/3 removes strong 1:4 resonance. Standard Neimark–Sacker theorem gives locally normally attracting invariant Jordan curve of radius (2/3)r^(3/2)*sqrt(beta-beta_c)+O(beta-beta_c). At criticality inverse-square radius grows by 3/(2r^2)+o(1), hence |z_n|~r sqrt(2/(3n)) for nearby nonfixed trajectories. Epsilon=1/2 specializes beta_c=6 and cubic -3; not a global basin or rotation number claim. Independently checked exact normal form algebra at rational epsilon and numerical local behavior.
